Bikini_Hoarding_Package.pdf: Bikini on the Beach: Hoarding Package BSG · 20/10/2026 · Prepared by Gus A 10.4 m run of melamine hoarding, 4.5 m high, set 1.2 m out from the Bikini on the Beach shopfront, with a 1.6 m double-door entry starting 1.2 m from the left end of the front. Item Size Shopfront (lease line) 8 m Returns 1.2 m each side Total hoarding length 10.4 m (1.2 + 8 + 1.2) Height 4.5 m Hoarding entry 1.6 m wide x 2.4 m high, 2 leaves Entry position 1.2 m from the left end of the front (1200 to 2800), in front of the shop entry and set to use full sheets Melamine 11 sheets 1200 x 3600 (9 in the layout + 2 spare in case of damage); tops cut from offcuts (not new sheets): 7 x 1200 x 900 + 1 x 400 x 900 Contents: 1. Hoarding limit on photo · 2. Plan and elevation · 3. Melamine layout · 4. Suggested Build Sequence · 5. Site checks · 6. Materials form 1. Hoarding limit on the photo The red outline is the hoarding limit on the floor; the crossed box is the entry. The entry starts 1.2 m from the left end of the front.
2. Plan and elevation All sizes in mm. The dashed red line is the lease line (the shopfront): nothing is fixed to it.

3. Melamine layout and cutting plan Each panel is numbered by the sheet it is cut from. Full sheets S1 to S7 go in whole; the cut pieces sit at the corners. S8 gives the 400 strip for the front right. S9 is turned sideways and cut to one 1600 x 1200 piece above the entry. Note: instead of cutting S9, the door-top pieces can be cut in the factory from a spare sheet and sent to the job. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T7 go in whole. T8 is cut 400. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 900 piece cut from S9.

4. Suggested Build Sequence Build left to right as seen from the mall: left return, front, right return. 1 Check the truck. Before leaving, check the truck against the materials form to make sure all the material was loaded, including the 2 spare sheets. 2 Arrive and secure the area. Sign in with centre management. Set up barrier tape and the bollard around the work zone. Lay the dust suppression. 3 Set out the hoarding limit. Mark both ends of the lease line and measure 1200 out from each. Snap the 8000 front line parallel to the shopfront. 4 Mark the entry. Measure 1200 from the left end of the front line and mark a 1600 opening (1200 to 2800). 5 Stand the Titan uprights. 10 uprights, each one at a joint between two sheets (never in the middle of a sheet), including one each side of the entry, 7 counterweights on each (weight matrix for 4.5 m). They are marked on the melamine layout. Plus 1 spare upright (10%), not placed on the layout, with its 7 counterweights. 77 counterweights are sent (11 x 7). 6 Frame the walls. Fix the 70 x 45 MGP 10 studs (4.5 m) so every melamine joint lands on a stud. Frame the entry with 2 x 4.5 m and 4 x 2.3 m door studs and a head at 2400. 7 Fix the 3600 sheets. Left return S1; front left S2; front right S3, S4, S5, S6, S8 (400, at the corner); right return S7. 8 Fill above the entry. One 1600 x 1200 piece (S9) between the door head at 2400 and 3600. 9 Fix the tops. 900 tops from 3600 to 4500 along the whole run. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T7 go in whole. T8 is cut 400. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 900 piece cut from S9. 10 Hang the doors. Two 2340 leaves on 4 hinges, metal plates and deadbolt. Check they close and lock. 11 Finish. White tape on every vertical joint, black skirting tape along the base, screw covers, anti-tampers, 6 warning stickers, paint touch-ups. 12 Hand over. Clean up, remove the barrier, photograph each side, complete the installation certificate and sign INST CHK. 5. Site checks Confirm before fixing anything; update the drawings if any differ. [ ] The front measures 8000. [ ] The ceiling is above 4500 along the whole run. [ ] The entry starts 1200 from the left end of the front. [ ] The 1200 returns leave the walkway centre management requires. [ ] Nothing is fixed to the shopfront or floor; the Titan counterweights hold the hoarding. 6. Materials form follows on the next page.
